jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Senior Product Manager

Location: Germany · Munich

Responsibilities

  • Lead requirements analysis, solution design discussions, and technical feasibility assessments, ensuring product requirements are clearly defined, measurable, and implementable.

  • Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from requirements gathering and prioritization to development, testing, release, and post-launch optimization.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration among Product, Engineering, QA, UX, and Operations teams to ensure efficient product delivery and alignment with business objectives.

  • Monitor product development progress, identify delivery risks, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure products are delivered on time and with high quality.

  • Work closely with technical teams to evaluate system architecture, platform capabilities, APIs, integrations, and scalability requirements, ensuring sustainable product evolution.

  • Define product success metrics, analyze product performance and user feedback, and continuously optimize product functionality and user experience based on data-driven insights.

  • Manage product-related vendor and outsourcing activities, ensuring external resources deliver according to quality, timeline, and technical expectations.

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Product Management, or related disciplines.

  • Proven experience in requirements management, backlog prioritization, stakeholder management, roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management.

  • Solid technical understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud services, system integrations, databases, and enterprise application platforms.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating business needs into technical solutions and vice versa.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and data-driven decision-making skills.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership abilities.

  • Demonstrated ownership mindset, execution capability, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with SaaS products, Cloud Platforms, Enterprise Software, or Digital Transformation initiatives.

  • Experience in the Renewable Energy, Energy Storage (BESS), Smart Energy, or Industrial Technology sectors.

  • Familiarity with system architecture design, API ecosystems, microservices, or cloud-native applications.

  • Experience working with global teams, distributed development organizations, or international vendors.

  • Knowledge of product analytics, user behavior analysis, and data-driven product optimization.

Product Owner (Microsoft, Koddex, outils collaboratifs)
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de la DSI d'Exotec, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille d'outils collaboratifs utilisés par nos Exopeople répartis en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.

Votre mission consistera à définir la vision, piloter l'évolution et maximiser l'adoption des solutions collaboratives qui soutiennent les activités de l'entreprise. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot, etc.) ainsi que sur Koddex, plateforme stratégique pour le partage des connaissances et la gestion de nos processus internes.

Véritable interface entre les métiers, les équipes IT et les partenaires externes, vous accompagnerez la transformation digitale d'Exotec en proposant des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée pour les utilisateurs.

Vos missions

Définir et piloter la stratégie produit

  • Porter la vision des outils collaboratifs et définir une roadmap cohérente avec les priorités métiers, la stratégie IT et les ambitions de transformation digitale d’Exotec.
  • Être responsable de la valeur produite par le portefeuille, en reliant chaque évolution à un résultat attendu pour les utilisateurs et l’entreprise.
  • Arbitrer les priorités du portefeuille en tenant compte de l’impact utilisateur, de l’adoption attendue, des contraintes techniques, des risques et de la soutenabilité des solutions.

Recueillir, challenger et prioriser les besoins

  • Être responsable de la discovery produit en recueillant des besoins de terrain auprès des utilisateurs, des métiers, de la DSI et des relais locaux en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.
  • Challenger les demandes et distinguer les besoins structurants des préférences locales, en s’appuyant sur les données d’usage, les retours utilisateurs et l’impact business.
  • Garantir que les décisions de priorisation et de roadmap reposent sur des éléments objectifs, des résultats mesurables et une compréhension réelle des usages.

Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements

  • Piloter le cycle complet des évolutions, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise à disposition, en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, l’intégration et la valeur délivrée.
  • Définir les critères de réussite et les standards de qualité des solutions, afin de sécuriser leur déploiement dans l’écosystème Exotec.
  • Prendre les décisions de release et de cycle de vie en équilibrant valeur utilisateur, risques opérationnels, dépendances éditeurs et pérennité des plateformes.

Développer l’adoption et animer la gouvernance

  • Définir et porter la stratégie d’adoption des outils collaboratifs afin d’ancrer durablement de nouveaux usages, au-delà de la seule communication ou de la formation.
  • Être responsable de l’adoption effective, de la satisfaction des utilisateurs et de la réduction des irritants qui limitent l’usage de Microsoft 365 et de Koddex.
  • Aligner les métiers, la DSI, les utilisateurs clés, les éditeurs et les partenaires externes sur les priorités, les règles de gouvernance, les arbitrages et les résultats attendus.
  • Piloter la relation avec les éditeurs et partenaires stratégiques, en maîtrisant leurs engagements, leur feuille de route, leurs risques et leurs contraintes commerciales dans l’intérêt d’Exotec.
  • Garantir la cohérence, la rationalisation et l’évolution maîtrisée du portefeuille d’outils collaboratifs et de l’écosystème de connaissances.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en Product Ownership, gestion de produit ou transformation digitale.
  • Bonne connaissance des outils collaboratifs, idéalement Microsoft 365.
  • Appétence pour les environnements SaaS et la conduite du changement.
  • Capacité à faire le lien entre enjeux métiers et solutions techniques.
  • Maîtrise des méthodes Agile.
  • Anglais professionnel.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

jobs.description:
About the role

As a Delivery Lead at Infinite Lambda, you'll hold accountability for the successful delivery of multi-workstream programmes for our most important clients. You will own the entire programme lifecycle — from commercial handover through to closure — coordinating multiple projects, teams, and delivery streams into a single coherent outcome. You will be a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including C-level executives, and the person our clients and our own leadership turn to when a programme hits a serious issue and needs a steady, credible hand to resolve it.

You are a critical partner in our client relationships, working closely with Account Managers to protect and grow long-term accounts, and with Executive Sponsors to keep governance sharp and escalations resolved quickly. Beyond delivery, you're expected to translate ambiguous, high-level business strategy into structured requirements and a deliverable roadmap — bringing the same rigour to business analysis as you do to programme governance.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of multi-workstream programmes spanning multiple projects, vendors, and delivery teams, using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches tailored to each client and phase.

  • Hold ultimate accountability for programme scope and benefits realisation across the full programme lifecycle.

  • Act as the escalation point for serious programme issues: recover programmes that are off-track, re-baseline commercials and timelines where needed, and manage the client conversations that come with it.

  • Design and enforce programme-level governance models, RAID processes, and reporting standards, ensuring predictable, high-quality execution is visible at every level from delivery team to executive sponsor.

  • Facilitate steering committees, delivering clear, credible updates and recommendations to C-level stakeholders on both the client and Infinite Lambda side.

  • Build and hold relationships with senior client stakeholders and executive sponsors, acting as a trusted voice in high-stakes conversations, difficult trade-offs, and commercial negotiations.

  • Lead business analysis at a programme level: gather and structure high-level business requirements and strategic objectives, and translate them into a coherent programme roadmap, benefits case, and workstream breakdown.

  • Identify and manage cross-workstream dependencies, escalating and closing them out before they threaten delivery.

  • Constructively challenge technical and commercial assumptions across workstreams, guiding recovery plans and trade-off decisions between engineering quality, cost, and delivery speed at a programme level.

  • Own commercial governance for the programme, including Change Control, Change Orders, and milestone sign-off, working closely with Account Managers and Executive Sponsors to protect margin and client trust.

  • Represent Infinite Lambda credibly in the most demanding client conversations — the ones where relationships, not just delivery plans, are on the line.

Requirements

Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex, multi-workstream programmes, with a strong focus on data warehouse migration and/or AI.

  • Consulting background, ideally within data or technology consultancies.

  • Track record of taking accountability for troubled or at-risk programmes and successfully recovering them — commercially and operationally.

  • Demonstrated business analysis experience at a strategic level — translating executive-level business objectives into structured requirements, benefits cases, and roadmaps.

  • Extensive experience with agile methodologies at programme scale, including managing dependencies and governance across multiple concurrent workstreams.

  • Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and data delivery principles, sufficient to challenge, guide, and support technical leadership across several workstreams at once.

  • Significant experience in business change as well as IT delivery, at an enterprise or large-account level.

  • Gravitas, credibility, and maturity to engage, influence, and hold difficult conversations with C-level stakeholders on both client and internal sides.

  • Commercial experience: negotiating Change Orders, managing fixed-cost and T&M commercial models, and protecting margin under pressure.

  • Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the need of the client and depending on the client some travel is required.

Skills:

  • Proficiency in a variety of programme and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello).

  • Strong business analysis toolkit at programme scale: requirements gathering, benefits mapping, process mapping, and senior stakeholder workshops.

  • Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, and change management skills, particularly under pressure or in adversarial situations.

  • Ability to structure a complex, ambiguous programme into a clear workstream breakdown, dependency map, and governance model.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent programmes or a large single programme with several parallel workstreams.

  • Familiarity with a range of delivery methodologies and the judgement to select and adapt the right one per workstream.

Mindset:

  • Comfortable holding ultimate accountability, including for issues you didn't personally cause.

  • Calm and decisive under pressure — the person the room looks to when a programme is at risk.

  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate the big picture across multiple workstreams while still tracking the details that matter.

  • A collaborative and positive approach to people, balanced with the willingness to have difficult conversations early.

  • Willingness to take new directions and adapt to changing priorities at short notice.

Nice to have Skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts.

  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Omni, Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI).

  • Formal programme management certification (e.g. MSP, PMI-PgMP) or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Proven experience leading data warehousing and analytics programmes, preferably migrations, at enterprise scale.

Soft skills

  • Servant leadership mindset with the ability to manage, motivate, inspire and support Project Managers and delivery teams.

  • Outstanding communication skills, calibrated for C-level and executive audiences.

  • A considerate, curious, positive, naturally collaborative and supportive approach to people, without shying away from hard conversations.

  • Proactivity regarding risk, issues and planning, especially the risks that haven't surfaced yet.

  • Ability to present complex technical and commercial concepts clearly to non-technical, senior audiences.

  • Natural problem-solving attitude, strong facilitation skills, and sound judgement under ambiguity.

  • Proficiency in English.

Interview Process

  • Take-home technical and case-based assignment.

  • Technical interview with Head of Programme Management: 60 minutes.

  • Cultural interview with Chief of Customer Success

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

  • The benefits are plenty, with private health insurance, work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

 

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Identity and Access Management
jobs.description:
Identity and access sits underneath everything our customers do with DataSnipper. It determines how organisations are set up, how their people sign in, who can see and do what, and how that is evidenced to the security teams and auditors who check. It needs to be secure by default and reliable enough that nobody has to think about it.

Our customers are audit firms and finance teams working with confidential financial data, from regional practices to the largest global networks. Getting identity and access right is a large part of why they trust us, and a large part of how we win and grow enterprise customers.

You will own product strategy and direction for identity and access across our platform. Your users are customer administrators and IT and security teams, and the product teams across DataSnipper that build on what you provide. You will work with a dedicated engineering team in Amsterdam.

About DataSnipper

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

 

What you'll own

  • Own how customers sign in, how their users are provisioned and managed, and how access is granted, reviewed and removed

  • Shape an access model that product teams across the company build on, so access behaves consistently everywhere in the product and is hard to misuse

  • Give large organizations the controls they need to manage access at scale: who can use what, how users are grouped, and how provisioning works with their own identity provider

  • Make administration simple enough that customer IT and security teams can manage their organisation without needing us, working closely with other product teams on the admin experience

  • Work out how access should work as automation and AI take on more of the work: what they are allowed to do, on whose behalf, and how it is recorded

  • Make least privilege the easy option rather than the tedious one, balancing security against usability, and the needs of smaller customers against the largest enterprises

  • Run a platform roadmap that other teams plan against: gather what product and engineering teams across the company need, agree ownership and sequencing with them, and make dependencies visible early

  • Act as the product voice in enterprise security reviews, and translate security, privacy and compliance requirements into product decisions

  • Lead across functions without formal authority, bringing engineering, design, security, customer success and sales into one plan, with explicit trade-offs and measurable results

     

What you'll bring

Must-have:

  • 5+ of product management in B2B SaaS, including platform or infrastructure products that other teams build on

  • Experience with identity and access in enterprise products: single sign-on (SAML, OIDC), user provisioning (SCIM), and role-based or fine-grained permissions across organisations with complex structures. Strong technical depth and real interest in the space can substitute for direct experience

  • Enough technical depth to work as a peer with engineers on authentication and authorization design, and to write specifications engineers review for feasibility

  • Experience with enterprise customers: security reviews, IT administrators and procurement requirements

  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and FedRAMP, and how they shape identity and access requirements

  • Experience running a platform roadmap with several dependent teams as its customers, and aligning product, engineering, design and go-to-market around it without formal authority

  • Clear written communication, and the ability to explain trade-offs to engineers, customers and leadership

  • Hands-on use of AI tools to accelerate learning, productivity, and team collaboration

Strong-to-have:

  • Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, Okta or WorkOS

  • Products for regulated industries such as audit, financial services, legal or healthcare

  • A background in software engineering

  • Experience defining access for AI or automated systems

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers set up their organisation and manage their users without needing our support

  • Product teams build on a shared access model and plan against a roadmap they trust, instead of building their own

  • Enterprise security reviews move quickly and rarely raise identity concerns

  • Access for automated and AI-driven work is clear, controlled and auditable

  • Sign-in and access are reliable enough that customers and internal teams rarely have to think about them

 

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Product discussion with members of product and engineering team

  • Practical exercise, scoped to under two hours

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

jobs.title: GCP Program Manager
jobs.description:
Build and lead residential workshops that help exceptional people pursue high-impact work in AI safety, biosecurity, and policy.

We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis.


About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

  • Generator Residency: In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from OpenAI, AI Futures Project, METR, and more.

  • Global Challenges Project: A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley.

  • Pathfinder Fellowship: Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work.

We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem.

 

The Role

The Global Challenges Project (GCP) runs three-day residential workshops that help talented individuals explore careers in AI safety and biosecurity. Over the past few years, GCP has run dozens of workshops for 400+ students, mostly in Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley. GCP has a long and successful track record and became part of Kairos in early 2026.

We’re now expanding GCP into a full portfolio of workshops serving different audiences and career stages, with the ambition of becoming the leading fieldbuilding workshop organizer in AI safety and biosecurity. This means building new programs, new formats, and the systems to deliver reliably at scale.

We’re looking for a GCP Program Manager to build and lead at least two strands of our expanding workshop portfolio, reporting to Sam Glendenning, who leads the Global Challenges Project.

You’ll have broad ownership of your programs, from deciding what they should achieve and who they should serve through to delivering the workshops themselves. This includes outreach and marketing strategy, participant selection, guest recruitment, workshop design, team leadership, in-person delivery, and impact evaluation.

This is an unusually hands-on role. You’ll shape the strategy behind your programs, build the systems needed to run them effectively, and then lead them in person. Because we run our portfolio experimentally, individual programs may change or be discontinued, but this role is not tied to any single program. You’ll own a portfolio that evolves as we learn what works.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own two or more GCP programs. You’ll take responsibility for their strategy, design, delivery, and evaluation. Programs you may own include:

    • Workshops for students newer to AI safety, for professionals considering a pivot into AI safety, or for accelerating people into politics or policy

    • Workshop support for other organizations, from advice and coordination to running workshops on their behalf

    • A high-impact format you propose (we’re open to strong cases for new programs)

  • Run programs experimentally. We’re testing which of these programs offer the most value to the ecosystem. You’ll experiment with both the format and purpose of your workshops, and be willing to discontinue programs that aren’t working, even after investing significant time in them.

  • Own outreach and participant selection. You’ll develop marketing and outreach strategies, build strong applicant pools, and decide who will benefit most from attending each program.

  • Build relationships and recruit guests. High-quality guests are central to the impact of our workshops. You’ll proactively build relationships across the field and invite researchers, policymakers, funders, operators, and other experts to participate.

  • Design excellent workshops. You’ll develop the structure, sessions, content, and participant experience for each program, holding everything to a very high standard.

  • Lead workshops in person. You’ll give talks, introduce guests, advise participants, manage the team on the ground, and take responsibility for how well each workshop runs.

  • Lead your program teams. We organize delivery program by program. You’ll direct the work of the GCP team, interns, and volunteers on your programs (typically three to four people per workshop). Once the team grows, you’ll likely line-manage one GCP team member and our interns.

  • Measure impact and iterate. You’ll collect structured feedback at every workshop, track participant outcomes over the following months, and use the evidence to improve, scale, or discontinue programs.

  • Help GCP scale. You’ll contribute to team-wide strategy, build operational structures and automation that let us expand without compromising quality, and help design and launch our internship program.

 

Who You Are

  • Experienced at running events. You’ve organized and delivered events such as workshops, conferences, or retreats, and you’re comfortable making game-time decisions. Strong project delivery experience in complex in-person settings can substitute.

  • Mission-aligned. You care deeply about how the development of advanced AI and biotechnology plays out, and you believe workshops can be a highly effective way to help talented people enter these fields.

  • Good with people, and energized by workshops. Leading three-day residential events is central to this role. You’ll need the energy to engage with participants and guests throughout while keeping the event running smoothly.

  • Comfortable managing a small team. Within a year, you’ll likely begin managing 2 or more people. Prior experience managing operational or programmatic teams is a strong plus.

  • High agency. You’ll have significant ownership over your programs, and we expect you to spot problems early, adapt when plans change, and fix things without waiting to be asked.

  • Highly organized. You’ll oversee several programs simultaneously, each with different workstreams, teams, and deadlines. You’ll need strong systems for keeping everything on track.

  • Familiar with the AI safety ecosystem. You know the major organizations and people in the field and understand how its parts fit together. You use that context to make good strategic decisions and to point participants toward the right opportunities. Familiarity with biosecurity or US policy is a plus, and matters more for some programs than others.

 

Why Work With Us

  • You’ll work toward reducing risks from advanced AI and biotechnology, two of the most important challenges of our time. Both fields need far more talented people than they have, and our workshops move promising people into careers working on them.

  • You’ll build and develop your own programs, lead the teams delivering them, and see the results firsthand.

  • GCP already has a strong brand, an excellent reputation, and a long track record. You’ll build on one of the ecosystem’s most successful workshop programs while joining a team with the ambition to become the leading workshop organizer in the space.

  • You’ll work closely with high-profile guests across AI safety and biorisk, developing a strong professional network.

  • We’re building a world-class team, so you’ll be in good company. Work alongside people who’ve come to Kairos from METR, Coefficient Giving, Rethink Priorities, the UK AI Security Institute, and CEA who share your commitment to impact.

 

What We Offer

  • Salary: $140,000–$195,000 (baseline), $175,000–$245,000 (supported hubs, like London, DC, Boston, and NYC), or $195,000–$270,000 (San Francisco Bay Area), depending on experience, with potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates

  • Location: This is a remote role. We provide access to office space in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, with optional coworking elsewhere. If you work from an AI safety office in one of these cities, we cover food, lunches, and office expenses. If you work from home, we cover home office expenses.

  • Benefits: Flexible working hours, highly competitive health insurance, dental and vision coverage, generous vacation policy, and professional development budget

  • Team retreats: We host all-team retreats three times a year to connect in person, collaborate, and build team culture.

  • Travel: Work-related travel and expenses covered.

 

Logistics

  • Start date: Ideally by October or early November 2026, with flexibility for the right candidate

  • This is a remote role, with travel roughly 8 to 12 times a year (typically 3 to 6 days at a time) for workshops, conferences, and events, predominantly in the UK and US.

  • We’re a remote-first organization, but because of how the GCP team works, we have a preference for candidates within five hours of UK time. Our current team spans GMT-8 to GMT+1, and we’ll gladly consider exceptional candidates elsewhere, including in the US.

  • We may be able to sponsor visas for the UK or US, depending on individual circumstances, including but not limited to O-1A visas. We can’t make guarantees regarding visa approval.

 

Our Culture

We’re a small, high-trust team motivated by the urgent challenge of making advanced AI go well. We try hard to figure out where we’re wrong, which means we say uncomfortable things to each other and change our minds fairly often. We value collaborative truth-seeking, a scout mindset, agility, and an alliance mindset with the broader ecosystem.

We also believe meaningful work should be enjoyable. We support each other’s well-being, celebrate wins, and maintain a healthy sense of humor even when the work is hard.

 

Application Process

We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

  1. Application form (10–20 mins)

  2. Take-home assignment (2–4 hours, paid)

  3. Interview (45 mins)

  4. Reference checks

  5. Work trial (3 days, paid)

  6. Offer

If you’re excited about this role but unsure whether you meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re interested in multiple roles, apply to the one that best fits your skills and interests, and note in your application the other roles that you’d like to be considered for.

This role’s scope, salary, and responsibilities may evolve, and we’ll keep you in the loop about any changes if you apply.

AI tools help us review applications. If we receive more apps than we can read, some may be declined based on the AI review alone. Learn more →

 

Questions? Reach out at Know someone who might be a good fit? If your referral gets hired and completes two months with us, we’ll pay you a $10,000 referral bonus. Learn more here.

About The Company:

Our consultants become an extension of our clients' teams, providing project and program leadership, PMO support, and execution expertise that keeps critical initiatives moving forward. With operations in the United States and the United Kingdom, MustardSeed serves clients across international markets through a fully distributed team. We look for professionals who are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges while making a measurable impact for our clients.

About the Role:

As a Sr. Project Manager at MustardSeed, you will be contributing to end-to-end project delivery within specified timeframes, budgets, and quality standards. As an experienced project manager already, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure the best possible outcomes, steering multidisciplinary teams towards common goals.

The Sr. Project Manager is the chief “make sure it happens – and happens right” person on the project and has the overall responsibility for ensuring that the outputs from each project phase – the initiation, planning, execution and closing phases – are delivered according to the requirements established and approved for that phase, and that these outputs are consistent across all phases.

You will contribute to a wide variety of different projects while maintaining a focus on project management best practices and stakeholder satisfaction.

Previous projects our team has facilitated include but are not limited to creating a robust integrated master schedule (IMS) for an upcoming clinical trial, identifying, and eliminating bottlenecks in a new product introduction (NPI) process, completing a transformative overhaul of a client’s product lifecycle management (PLM) process, ensuring the successful delivery of a newly acquired software, overhauling a client’s supply chain management (SCM) practices.

This is a remote position – supporting customers virtually with rare travel to customer sites.

If you are highly skilled and enjoy challenging, important work while retaining the flexibility your life needs, we would like to talk to you!

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Ensure that communication within and between organizations involved in the various phases is occurring effectively, and that management and other stakeholders are kept informed of progress, as necessary.

  • Develop a detailed project plan to monitor and track progress while managing changes to project scope, project schedule, and project cost.

  • Define project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.

  • Perform project risk assessments, including, among others, the risk of exceeding the budget, not meeting schedules, and technology risks.

  • Understand, assess, and embed the right delivery methodologies, considering the project and business constraints.

  • Utilize appropriate Program Management Best Practices throughout the project duration.

  • Track project performance, specifically to analyze the successful completion of short and long-term goals.

Skills Required:

  • Ability to think strategically and tactically about product, technical, and cross-functional issues.

  • Excellent client-facing and internal verbal and written communication skills.

  • High-caliber organizational skills (e.g., attention to detail, multitasking, etc.).

  • Proven leadership and experience in project management.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) / Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus.

 

Compensation & Benefits:

Salary is commensurate with experience. We offer comprehensive benefits including a company sponsored Individual Coverage Healthcare Reimbursement Arrangement (ICHRA), 401(K), Healthcare Savings Account (HSA), Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, and paid company holidays, Additionally, MustardSeed offers robust support for our team members’ professional development, employee incentives, and hands-on experience in a wide variety of projects and environments.

 

Additional Information:

MustardSeed provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

A quick note about this opportunity:

MustardSeed is a project management consulting firm. Our project managers are embedded within our clients' organizations to lead and support critical initiatives across multiple industries. As we continue to grow and bring on new clients, we're continually expanding our team of experienced project managers. While this may be the same role you've seen before, it's because we're building our talent pipeline to meet ongoing client demand.

Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager - Security
jobs.description:
About our team:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our product team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Job Summary:

As a Senior/Principal Product Manager - Security, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Radiant’s security capabilities across the cloud platform.

You’ll work across identity, access control, secrets, network security, platform hardening, auditability, compliance controls, and customer-facing security features, partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, compliance, and customers.

This is a highly technical product role focused on making security embedded, scalable, automated, and easy to consume across the platform.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for security products and platform capabilities.

  • Define the product experience across IAM, RBAC, secrets, encryption, audit logging, network controls, and policy management.

  • Translate customer, regulatory, and internal security requirements into clear product requirements, APIs, workflows, and priorities.

  • Partner with engineering and security teams on secure-by-design architecture, controls, automation, and platform hardening.

  • Drive customer-facing capabilities for access control, security visibility, compliance evidence, and governance.

  • Improve automation around policy enforcement, configuration, detection, remediation, and security posture.

  • Work with commercial and customer-facing teams on enterprise security requirements and security reviews.

  • Define success metrics across control coverage, adoption, security posture, operational overhead, and customer trust.

  • Evaluate build vs. buy vs. partner decisions across the cloud security ecosystem.

Qualifications:

  • Experience owning technical products, cloud security products, infrastructure platforms, IAM, or developer-facing security tooling.

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud and infrastructure security.

  • Strong technical fluency across:

    • Identity & access: IAM, RBAC, SSO, federation, service identities

    • Security controls: encryption, secrets management, key management, policy enforcement

    • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, cloud networking, compute, storage

    • Security operations: logging, audit trails, detection, vulnerability management

    • APIs & automation: policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, security integrations

  • Familiarity with technologies such as Vault, OPA, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes security tooling, SIEM platforms, cloud KMS, or similar.

  • Strong understanding of multi-tenancy, least privilege, zero-trust principles, threat models, and shared-responsibility models.

  • Able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, and customer experience.

  • Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

What you bring:

  • Security mindset: Understand risk and controls without losing sight of product usability.

  • Product thinking: Turn security requirements into clear, scalable platform capabilities.

  • Technical fluency: Work credibly across identity, infrastructure, networking, APIs, and distributed systems.

jobs.title: Product Manager - CDI
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

 

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

 

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).

Ton objectif : générer un flux régulier de leads qualifiés pour l'équipe commerciale, à un coût d'acquisition maîtrisé, et faire de Solteo une référence de l'électrification des bâtiments auprès des installateurs. Tu accompagneras aussi le lancement de nos nouvelles offres.

 

Missions et responsabilités

Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact.

Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup, où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis.

  1. Discovery continue

Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact.

  1. Shaping & conception

Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe.

  1. Delivery & impact

Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer.

  1. Ownership & autonomie

Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet.

 

Tes objectifs:

⭐ Les 30 premiers jours — Comprendre

Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business.

Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit.

🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap.

jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

About the role

The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, some of our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab, and working to restore the voices of one million people living with permanent voice loss through our 1 Million Voices initiative (learn more at elevenlabs.io/impact). As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast, this quarter alone includes 5+ events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight.

What you'll do

  • Coordinate production of Impact's documentary case studies: travel and work onsite for filming when needed, work closely with external production and direction teams, bringing opinions on story and craft, and partner with our Design team to make sure every film meets ElevenLabs' bar and brand guidelines.

  • Plan and execute Impact's conferences and activations alongside the Events team, turning each one into an in-person moment that drives real ROI and leaves a lasting impression, with Impact's own storytelling angle built in.

  • Support Comms in telling Impact's story through PR, coordinating with Comms and, when applicable, a PR agency to keep press windows and partner announcements on track, and helping make sure Impact's international stories get told well as the program expands globally.

  • Partner with Design to keep all video and static collateral on-brand, advocating for a high creative standard and Impact’s lens.

  • Carry a consistent visual and narrative thread across launches, blog content, and ElevenLabs Summit presentations.

  • Draft copy for social and blog content, collaborating with Comms to land a final draft, and with Design on all launch-related visual assets.

  • Manage multiple concurrent launches, shoots, and events at once.

Requirements

  • A great project manager with a sharp creative eye, someone who runs cross-functional logistics flawlessly, has real taste, and will push the team to hit it.

  • Strong writing and visual taste; can tell when something is on-brand and polish-worthy.

  • 2-5 years of experience in production, events, or brand marketing.

Company Overview

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. The Role

As Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery, you will sit at the handoff point between ideas and engineering — taking a raw idea or ask and shaping it into a well-formed request the software team can build against. You own the what: defining the problem, scope, and acceptance criteria behind every request. Working alongside the Project Manager, who runs sprints and day-to-day delivery mechanics, you'll advocate for how requests should be sequenced and when they should land, making sure priority calls reflect the needs behind the work rather than just what's next in the queue.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Turn ideas into formal requests: work with the Product Lead and other stakeholders to take a defined ask and translate it into a clear, engineering-ready ticket — problem statement, scope, acceptance criteria, and any relevant regulatory or clinical context — before it enters the backlog.

  • Own and prioritise the software ticket pipeline in Jira: intake, triage, and grooming, so the backlog reflects real, current priority rather than the order things happened to arrive in.

  • Own the idea-to-documentation handoff with the software team — making sure every piece of work that reaches engineering has the context, requirements, and supporting documentation it needs in Confluence, and that decisions made along the way are captured rather than lost in Slack.

  • Advocate for how and when work should happen: partner with the Project Manager, who owns sprint planning and delivery mechanics, to make sure sequencing and timing reflect genuine priority rather than convenience.

  • Keep the software pipeline's information in the right place — Jira for delivery, Confluence for documentation — rather than in slide decks or side channels, and help extend that operating model as the team grows.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, or Product Owner working directly with a software engineering team, ideally in a regulated or safety-conscious environment.

  • Comfort writing requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for engineers to build against without repeated back-and-forth.

  • A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

  • Comfortable in an early-stage environment where requests arrive informally and priorities shift, and where part of the job is imposing structure rather than just following it.

  • Drawn to the operational side of product management — energised by getting the machinery of idea-to-delivery running smoothly, not just by defining the vision.

You'll own a new extension of the Poki user experience end to end, from market and audience research and pricing to product vision, roadmap, launch and iteration. You'll work closely with product leadership, data, and our business and commercial teams, and keep leadership regularly updated on progress and learnings.

You'll be building something new from a blank page, with the reach of over 100 million monthly players behind you and a dedicated team from day one. If the product succeeds, you'll own a new pillar of Poki and can grow into leading the product line and the team around it.

Your Challenge as a Senior Product Manager

  • Validate the opportunity. You'll turn market, audience and pricing research into a clear product thesis and business case. Within your first 3 months, that means a validated product thesis and a research-backed pricing direction.

  • Find traction. You'll iterate from early signals to a product with proven adoption and a roadmap leadership buys into. At 12 months, success means early traction against agreed targets.

  • Decide fast with incomplete data. The work comes with high ambiguity and few existing answers, so you'll need to make decisions before the data is complete and set your own metrics.

  • Keep a new team focused. You'll keep your dedicated team focused while the product finds its shape.

You

  • Have 6+ years of Product Management experience on web-scale consumer products used by millions. You understand consumer behaviour and scale at Poki's level.

  • Experience with consumer subscriptions, in-app purchases or other direct monetisation models

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.
