jobs.title: Solution Consultant - R&D
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

  • Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.

  • Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.

  • Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.

  • Provide leadership by creating reusable solutions, content, and trainings for key areas. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success.

     

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

  • Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.

  • Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.

  • Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.

  • Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.

  • Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.

  • Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar. The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar. Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not. You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

  • You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad.
  • Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop.
  • 3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't.
  • Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses.
  • Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube.
  • Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure.
  • Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents.
  • You can shoot and cut video yourself.
  • Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography.
  • Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • Colleagues in 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

jobs.title: Product Manager Operations

Zit het in je aard om te ontrafelen hoe een proces nóg efficiënter kan? Als Product Manager Operations ben je de drijvende kracht achter de uitvoering van procesverbeteringen in onze operatie. Je duikt diep in de data, spoort knelpunten op en ondersteunt de Product Manager Operations bij het vertalen en opleveren van concrete oplossingen samen met ons development team.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, prioriteren en realiseren van aanpassingen aan onze operations tooling. Dit doe je om de groei van Crisp op een slimme en efficiënte manier te faciliteren.

Als ideale kandidaat heb je enige ervaring opgedaan binnen het Product Management vakgebied.   • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.

You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

  • Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

  • Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

  • Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines.

  • Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

  • Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions.

  • Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve.

  • Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

Who you are

  • Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

  • Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

  • Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

  • Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

  • Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Et ce poste alors ?

Le rôle

Pour accélérer notre croissance en France et à l’international, nous recherchons notre premier Sales Manager (futur VP Sales). Rattaché(e) directement à Manon (co-founder), qui porte ce rôle aujourd'hui, tu seras un(e) véritable builder, pour transformer un processus de vente encore artisanal en une machine performante, outillée et scalable, au service d'objectifs de croissance ambitieux.

Ce rôle allie une forte implication opérationnelle et une dimension stratégique : tu accompagnes l'équipe au plus près du terrain, tout en structurant notre organisation commerciale et en définissant notre stratégie de croissance.

jobs.description:

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. About Refractal

Refractal is an AI security company building the infrastructure organisations need to defend against autonomous AI threats. 2026 has shown that generally capable intelligence is here. The challenge now is modernising security to stop AI-enabled threats, whether they come from internal agents going rogue or from attackers using AI to become more dangerous.

Refractal was founded on cybersecurity and AI expertise from MIT, Microsoft, NASA and the U.S. Navy. Our product lets organisations detect AI-enabled threats at low cost without sacrificing detection quality. We take a practical approach to AI risk, combining proven cybersecurity methods with frontier AI security research.

Today, we work with governments and organisations that can't afford to get security wrong. We're backed by leading deep-tech and cybersecurity investors and are growing the team to deliver on this mission.

The role

You'll look after Refractal's UK and European customers once they've signed. You'll lead onboarding, drive adoption and manage each account through renewal and expansion, so customers get clear, measurable value from the product.

What you'll do

  • Lead onboarding and implementation plans with customers' security, risk and AI teams, alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers.

  • Act as the technical point of contact: troubleshoot integrations, manage escalations and coordinate fixes with engineering.

  • Track adoption and outcomes, and run regular business reviews with customer stakeholders.

  • Own renewals and identify expansion opportunities with our Account Executives.

  • Turn customer feedback into clear product requirements, and build the playbooks and documentation behind technical account management.

Success in your first six months

  • Your customers are live, use Refractal regularly and can point to the value it delivers.

  • Escalations are handled quickly and transparently, with fixes tracked to closure.

  • You've built a repeatable onboarding and account-review process the team can scale.

About you: essential

  • 5+ years as a technical account manager, customer success engineer or similar in B2B software, ideally security.

Nice to have

  • Experience with regulated customers in financial services, healthcare or the public sector.

  • Familiarity with the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001.

Our values

Radical transparency. We believe the best work happens when everyone feels able to give and receive honest, constructive feedback.

Public service. We see AI security as a form of public service. Getting the AI transition right means putting the right infrastructure in place to manage the threats that come with it, and our work helps protect the institutions and services society depends on.

Fail fast. We test ideas early, seek feedback and learn quickly. We experiment rapidly and change course when something isn't working, without compromising on security.

Pragmatism, not dogmatism. We choose approaches based on how well they solve the problem. That means combining established cybersecurity methods with frontier AI research, questioning our assumptions, and changing our minds when the evidence changes.

jobs.title: Lead Credit Ops
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently serves around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model and distributes short-term financing to a subset of those customers through specialised financing partners. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams.

As Credit Operations Lead, you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes.

You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner.

This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

  • Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

  • Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

  • Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

  • Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

  • Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

  • Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.

First 6–12 months

  • Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

  • Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

  • Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

  • Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

  • Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

  • By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

  • Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

  • Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

  • Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

  • Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Risk & Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Waarom jouw rol belangrijk is

Als Senior Risk & Compliance Manager bij i3D.net geef je vorm aan de governance, het risicomanagement en de compliance op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging binnen onze internationale organisatie.

Het beheren van wereldwijde infrastructuur voor gaming en zakelijke klanten brengt grote verantwoordelijkheden met zich mee. Onze klanten vertrouwen erop dat wij hun diensten en gegevens beschermen. Tegelijkertijd vragen regelgeving zoals NIS2 en normenkaders zoals ISO 27001 ons om aan te tonen dat onze beheersmaatregelen goed zijn ingericht én in de praktijk effectief werken.

Je bepaalt de strategische richting, adviseert het senior management en bouwt onze Governance, Risk & Compliance-functie verder uit. Daarbij blijf je voldoende betrokken bij de dagelijkse operatie om te begrijpen wat er binnen de organisatie speelt en vereisten te vertalen naar praktische, werkbare oplossingen.

In deze invloedrijke rol help je i3D.net om de informatiebeveiliging te versterken, zich voor te bereiden op toekomstige ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving en een schaalbare GRC-functie op te bouwen voor de komende jaren.

Wat je gaat doen

  • GRC-strategie en roadmap: Je ontwikkelt en realiseert een meerjarige roadmap voor Governance, Risk & Compliance, afgestemd op onze bedrijfsstrategie, internationale activiteiten en veranderende wet- en regelgeving.

  • Leiderschap en teamontwikkeling: Je geeft leiding aan het GRC-team, coacht collega’s en ondersteunt de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je biedt duidelijke richting en helpt minder ervaren collega’s bij hun professionele groei.

  • Compliance en regelgeving: Je vertaalt regelgeving zoals NIS2 en de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet naar praktisch beleid, beheersmaatregelen, trainingen en acties binnen de organisatie.

  • Certificeringen en audits: Je leidt of coördineert certificeringstrajecten, gap-analyses, interne en externe audits en de gestructureerde opvolging van bevindingen.

  • Internationale governance: Je ondersteunt compliance binnen onze internationale organisatie en werkt samen met stakeholders in Nederland, Frankrijk, Canada en de Verenigde Staten, en met ons moederbedrijf Ubisoft.

  • Praktische ondersteuning: Je bent bereid om waar nodig zelf operationeel bij te dragen, terwijl je de strategische en leidinggevende focus van je rol bewaakt.

Relevante normenkaders en regelgeving

Bij i3D.net werk je met of draag je bij aan:

  • Informatiebeveiliging: ISO 27001 en de verdere ontwikkeling van ons managementsysteem voor informatiebeveiliging (ISMS).

  • Privacy en gegevensbescherming: ISO 27701 en relevante privacyvereisten.

  • Assurance: SOC 2, bij voorkeur met ervaring met SOC 2 Type II.

  • Risicomanagement en regelgeving: NIS2, de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet en andere relevante Europese en nationale vereisten.

  • Aanvullende normen: Ervaring met NEN 7510, ISO 9001 of ISO 50001 is waardevol.

  • Audits en beheersmaatregelen: Interne en externe audits, het toetsen van beheersmaatregelen, gap-analyses, risicoregisters en het beheren van bewijsmateriaal.

Wat je in het eerste jaar bereikt

  • Je hebt een duidelijke, door de directie gedragen GRC-roadmap opgesteld, met prioriteiten, verantwoordelijkheden, benodigde capaciteit en meetbare doelstellingen.

  • Je hebt het ISMS versterkt en ervoor gezorgd dat beleid, beheersmaatregelen, documentatie en bewijsmateriaal goed worden bijgehouden.

  • Je hebt belangrijke certificerings- en audittrajecten succesvol ondersteund en een gestructureerde aanpak opgezet voor het opvolgen van bevindingen.

  • Je hebt de verantwoordelijkheden en de samenwerking tussen GRC, Security, Technology en het senior management verduidelijkt.

  • Je hebt het GRC-team verder ontwikkeld en collega’s geholpen om met meer vertrouwen en zelfstandigheid te werken.

  • Je hebt verbeterd hoe informatiebeveiligings- en compliancerisico’s aan de directie worden toegelicht en worden vertaald naar zakelijke beslissingen.

  • Je hebt i3D.net en SmartDC voorbereid op relevante ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving, waaronder NIS2 en de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet.

  • Je bent uitgegroeid tot een betrouwbare en deskundige adviseur voor het senior management en stakeholders binnen de hele organisatie.

Jouw profiel

  • Ervaring: Je hebt circa tien jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen Governance, Risk & Compliance, informatiebeveiliging, securitymanagement, audit of een nauw verwant vakgebied.

  • Leiderschap: Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen en ontwikkelen van professionals binnen GRC, informatiebeveiliging, compliance of risicomanagement.

  • Kennis van regelgeving: Je hebt gedegen kennis van NIS2 en kunt wettelijke vereisten vertalen naar proportionele en werkbare maatregelen voor de organisatie.

  • Communicatie: Je beheerst het Engels vloeiend en kunt complexe risico’s helder uitleggen aan technische teams, operationele collega’s, klanten en het senior management.

  • Certificeringen: CISM heeft een sterke voorkeur vanwege de brede focus op management en governance. CISSP of vergelijkbare kwalificaties op senior niveau zijn eveneens zeer relevant.

  • Aanvullende expertise: Ervaring met SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27701, NEN 7510, ISO 9001, ISO 50001 of het werken binnen een certificerings- of auditorganisatie is een pre.

Waarom werken bij ons?

  • Internationale werkomgeving: We beheren ons eigen internationale backbonenetwerk en zijn aanwezig op meer dan 60 locaties wereldwijd.

  • Geavanceerde technologie: Je werkt met toonaangevende dienstverleners en moderne datacenterapparatuur.

  • Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden: Je ontvangt een goed salaris, ploegentoeslagen, een jaarlijkse bonus, 25 vakantiedagen naast de officiële feestdagen, een reiskostenvergoeding en een premievrij pensioen.

  • Professionele ontwikkeling: Je ontwikkelt je verder met loopbaanbegeleiding en een vergoeding voor opleidingen.

  • Gamingvoordelen: Je krijgt levenslang toegang tot de gamebibliotheek van Ubisoft.

  • Actief blijven en ontspannen: Maak gebruik van onze eigen fitnessruimte in Rotterdam of ontspan in de game- en muziekkamers.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer – (Golang, Data & Integrations)
jobs.description:
At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Why your role matters

You’ll own how business and customer data flows across the organization, with a focus on billing, product, and sales data. Working at the intersection of engineering, finance, and product, you’ll build the foundation that makes data reliable and auditable, removing manual reconciliation, stabilizing migrations, and ensuring billing flows and pricing models behave predictably at scale.

This is a backend engineering role, not a traditional data or ETL setup. Using Go, you’ll build services and APIs that expose billing logic and connect systems like HubSpot and NetSuite, shaping how data moves across the organization in production.

You’ll work on greenfield architecture and database design, defining customer data models, system relationships, and asset structures that determine what customers can buy and how it is invoiced, using SQL where needed for validation and reconciliation. You’ll be part of a team of five developers, working closely with a Business Analyst and owning these flows end to end.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own data migrations and pipelines: Design and implement ETL flows to move billing, contract, and asset data into target systems with full validation and rollback capability

  • Model and transform complex data structures: Analyze legacy databases, define transformation logic, and ensure consistent, idempotent data handling

  • Build scalable backend services in Go: Develop services and abstraction layers that expose billing logic and enforce business rules, while leveraging the right tools (e.g. SQL, Python) for data transformations and migrations

  • Standardize product and pricing models: Define reusable product and offer structures that work consistently across systems and integrations

  • Integrate external systems into billing flows: Connect ERP, CRM, payment, and inventory platforms with secure, reliable data exchange and reconciliation

  • Develop robust APIs and integrations: Build REST and gRPC APIs with strong validation, logging, retry logic, and monitoring

  • Automate migrations and operational processes: Create tooling, scripts, and runbooks that support repeatable migrations and controlled cutovers

  • Improve observability and incident response: Implement monitoring, dashboards, and alerting to quickly detect and resolve data or integration issues

  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Finance, Product, and Business Analysts to refine business rules and validate outputs

  • Mentor and contribute to architecture decisions: Share knowledge, review code, and help shape the long-term billing architecture

Tech stack

At i3D.net, you’ll work with:

  • Languages: Golang (primary), PHP (legacy), .NET

  • Infrastructure & Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, GitHub Actions

  • Databases: MariaDB

  • Practices: Test-Driven Development (TDD), CI/CD pipelines, Agile methodologies - we follow a "you build it, you deploy it, you support it" philosophy

  • IDE: Choose the development environment that you're most comfortable with

What success looks like in the first year

  • You’ve delivered reliable migration plans and scripts with rollback strategies, automated validation, and clear verification reporting

  • You’ve defined and documented data mappings and transformation rules, including legacy schemas, business logic, and edge cases

  • Standardized product, pricing, and billing models are implemented and consistently used across systems and integrations

  • Core billing APIs, services, and integrations are live, including payment flows and inventory sync, with validation, logging, and auditability

  • Monitoring, dashboards, and runbooks are in place, giving clear insight into data quality, system health, migrations, and incident handling

Your profile

  • Backend engineering: 5+ years of building production systems in Go, .NET, or PHP and comfortable using Go as the main language

  • Data and SQL: Experience with SQL, MariaDB, or Postgres and working with complex schemas

  • Migrations and ETL: You’ve designed transformation pipelines, written idempotent scripts, and built validation tooling

  • APIs and integrations: Built and integrated REST or gRPC APIs with authentication patterns like OAuth2 or JWT

  • 3rd party integrations: Connected systems such as ERP, CRM, payment providers, or inventory platforms

  • Infrastructure and automation: Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Terraform or Ansible

  • Testing and quality: Write unit, integration, and contract tests to ensure reliability

  • Ownership and communication: Take end-to-end responsibility and work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

  • Remote vs Onsite: This is a hybrid position with some onsite work required at our Rotterdam office. You are either already in the Netherlands or open to relocating here, and we provide relocation services to support your move (a valid EU work permit is necessary).

Why join us?

  • High ownership and real technical depth: You’ll design systems, not just implement them, and take full ownership from idea to production.

  • Make an Impact: Work on core projects that power global gaming and tech giants like Ubisoft.

  • Hybrid Work Setup: Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid role with a work-from-home budget and top-tier tools.

  • Competitive Perks: Enjoy great pay, shift bonuses, an annual bonus, 25 vacation days (excluding national holidays), travel allowance, and a premium-free pension.

  • Skill Development: Level up with career guidance and education reimbursement.

  • Gaming Perks: Get lifetime access to Ubisoft’s game library

  • Stay Active: Use our in-house gym in Rotterdam or unwind in the game and music rooms.

Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Care Operations Intelligence, the Director, Experience Intelligence & Quality owns the voice-of-customer (VoC) signal infrastructure that captures what Spring Health’s members, providers, employers, and payers are experiencing. Additionally, this leader will own the standards our frontline support and clinical teams are measured against: QA methodology, rubrics, calibration, and improvement strategy across every channel. This role will be responsible for continuing to shift the VoC and quality teams into an AI native organization. This is a full time, fully-remote position, though the ability to be onsite in our NYC office once a week is preferred.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and run the voice-of-customer / signal-synthesis capability: consolidate unstructured member, provider, employer, and payer feedback into a single signal infrastructure. Insights Ops teams can act on directly go to QA, Training, and function owners; systemic issues needing product, policy, or process change get surfaced to Process Engineering, Product, and other cross-functional partners.

  • Own an AI-native cross-channel quality strategy: one measurement standard, one defect taxonomy, one sampling approach, and one calibration process spanning AI-handled and human-handled interactions.

  • Partner with Process Engineering on the diagnose/fix boundary: this role sets the QA rubric and methodology that AI-failure diagnoses are scored against; day-to-day gap-log triage sits with Process Engineering pending the working-session decision on scope.

  • Design a signal- and defect-prioritization framework so the highest-impact issues get worked first, partnering with frontline leadership to design and evaluate quality improvement initiatives (e.g., training updates, workflow changes, automation opportunities).

  • Own the tool stack used across VoC and QA, including consolidating vendors where possible.

  • Build out and manage a high-leverage team spanning all elements of the quality and VoC cycle: VoC analysts, quality strategists, and QA reviewers led by a Senior Manager.

What success looks like:

  • A working VoC signal pipeline — feedback synthesized, prioritized, and routed — with a measurable VoC-driven action rate and shrinking insight-to-action cycle time.

  • One quality measurement standard and defect taxonomy in place across AI and human channels, replacing two divergent stacks.

  • QA coverage of support and clinical interactions increasing via automation, with calibration variance and inter-rater agreement inside range.

  • Reliable critical-error (compliance/HIPAA) catch rates.

  • Leadership and cross-functional partners have a trusted, evidence-based read on where quality is breaking and why, across AI and human-delivered service alike.

  • CSAT trending up across member, provider, employer, and payer groups.

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ years of experience in operations strategy, analytics, or a related role (e.g., management consulting), preferably within healthcare; 5+ years in a leadership role.

  • Experience running voice-of-customer or signal-management programs and turning unstructured feedback into prioritized, actionable insight.

  • Experience leading quality functions in a high-volume service delivery environment (healthcare, contact center, or similar).

  • Demonstrated ability to partner with senior executives to solve complex business challenges using data, structured analysis, and exceptional communication skills.

  • Track record integrating two teams or tools into one operating model (post-acquisition or post-reorg) without stalling either program mid-transition.

  • A builder’s mindset — comfortable establishing frameworks, processes, and standards in a scaling environment.

  • People leadership experience managing managers or multiple sub-functions.

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience building or scaling a QA function — scoring rubrics, calibration programs, inter-rater reliability — ideally including a shift from manual/sampling review toward AI-assisted or AI-native scoring.

  • Experience with AI-scoring / auto-QA platforms (e.g., Zendesk QA, Maestro QA or similar).

  • Background spanning both care/clinical delivery and RCM, claims, or another regulated, financial-services-adjacent operations environment.

  • Comfort operating with real ambiguity — this org is still being designed as part of an active M&A integration, and several ownership boundaries with Process Engineering aren't finalized yet.

Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline.

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer to embed directly with U.S. government and military customers and own the technical success of our C2 systems in the field. jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Network Engineer to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


Contabo Group operates one of Europe's largest cloud infrastructure platforms, with data centres across Europe and beyond. As our new Senior Network Engineer, you take on the network backbone that thousands of customers rely on every day, with real ownership from day one.

Right now, the biggest milestone on your plate is the build out of our new AI data centre. You inherit a fully designed Leaf-Spine architecture built on Arista EOS, BGP EVPN, and VXLAN, take ownership of it, refine it where it needs refining, and drive everything from commissioning through to stable production operations. Alongside that, you keep our existing LTG infrastructure running reliably: you design, build, and operate complex network, server, and security systems, analyse and resolve faults, and harden our network security through scrubbers, firewalls, ACLs, and NAC.

You monitor network traffic and infrastructure performance, extrapolate the KPIs that matter to management, and coordinate with external service providers and remote hands across the globe. You keep our network diagrams, runbooks, change logs, and system documentation in good shape, and you work closely with Platform Engineering on Cilium BGP peering, Kubernetes node network configuration, and IPAM, acting as the ongoing interface between NetOps and Platform.

You join a self-organising, agile team that owns its problems end to end, from analysis to resolution, without micromanagement. On top of that, you will have real room to grow into infrastructure automation, DDoS mitigation with Nokia Deepfield, observability, and BGP EVPN fabric engineering, alongside plenty of national and international project work.

You report directly to our Head of Network and become the permanent owner of everything networking related at Contabo Group, Blue and Black alike. Communication, team orientation, problem solving, and analytical thinking matter just as much here as deep technical expertise, since you will regularly work across teams and explain complex topics to people outside networking.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with complex, scalable networks and fabric infrastructures on Cisco and/or Arista, ideally with real Leaf-Spine and BGP EVPN VXLAN exposure
  • strong expertise in WAN connectivity, data centre peering, uplink management, VPN, and IPv6
  • strong expertise in security administration and DDoS mitigation (e.g. Nokia Deepfield, Aurologic), plus solid monitoring skills with tools like Grafana, Check_MK, or Zabbix
  • good scripting and automation skills with Ansible, Terraform, Python, or similar
  • strong analytical and strategic thinking, paired with clear, confident communication
  • a results-driven, hands-on mindset with a high standard of performance, customer orientation, and composure under pressure
  • genuine team spirit, reliability, and a self-driven way of working that thrives without micromanagement
  • experience with Network Access Control solutions, BGP Flowspec, virtualisation (Proxmox), and IPAM systems such as NetBox
  • strong conflict-handling skills, a knack for building contacts across teams, and openness to change
  • a basic understanding of Kubernetes networking, ideally paired with an Arista certification (or equivalent Cisco knowledge), a completed IT apprenticeship or equivalent, and German language skills alongside excellent English
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca

A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. jobs.title: Software Engineer – Revenue Operations (Leipzig)
jobs.description:
Description

Legartis is a leading Legal AI company transforming how organizations manage and work on their contracts. As we scale across DACH and into new European markets, our go to market engine needs an operational backbone that keeps pace with it. We are looking for a software engineer with RevOps tooling experience to own HubSpot and the integrations around it end to end, and to build our GTM stack into a reliable, well-engineered system that Sales, Marketing and Customer Success build on every day.


Your mission

  • Own HubSpot as our core GTM system: architecture, workflows, automations, custom properties and integrations across the wider tool stack, including Younium for subscription and billing data.
  • Design, build and operate the integrations and data pipelines between HubSpot, Younium and our product platform as production software: written in Python, version controlled, tested, monitored and deployed through CI/CD.
  • Build event driven integrations on our Kafka based platform, so that product, usage and billing events flow reliably into the GTM stack.
  • Design and enforce a clean data foundation, with consistent lifecycle stages, lead status, deal stages, attribution logic and territory and tier structures that hold up as the team grows.
  • Build and maintain the reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Marketing and leadership real time visibility into pipeline, forecast and rep level performance.
  • Partner closely with Sales leadership on the metrics that matter and own the infrastructure that surfaces them reliably.
  • Act as the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, keeping funnel definitions and handoffs consistent end to end.
  • Support forecasting, pipeline reviews and deal desk style workflows, including approvals and pricing exceptions, alongside Sales leadership.
  • Translate commercial priorities into system level changes: lead routing and scoring, territory design, comp structure alignment.


Your profile

  • 3 or more years as a software engineer, including hands on work with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations tooling, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, ideally in Python: clean, tested and maintainable code, version control, code review and CI/CD.
  • You code with AI every day: you use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to ship faster, and you have the engineering judgement to review, test and own what they produce.
  • A solid understanding of B2B sales processes and the tools around them: pipeline stages, lead routing, forecasting, quoting and billing.
  • A track record of integrating a CRM with other business tools (e.g. billing, marketing, support) via REST APIs and webhooks, writing the integration code yourself rather than relying on no code tools.
  • Understanding of event driven architectures and messaging systems such as Kafka: producers and consumers, idempotency, error handling and retries.
  • Comfortable with SQL and data modelling.
  • Nice to have: experience hosting and operating the services you build, e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure such as AWS, and monitoring.
  • Deep hands on HubSpot expertise at admin and API level: workflows, custom properties, reporting, permissions. Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus.
  • A track record of building or cleaning up CRM data foundations at scale, not just running reports on top of someone else's setup.
  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort turning messy data into a dashboard people actually use.
  • Experience working cross functionally with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and the confidence to push back when something does not add up.
  • A structured, ownership driven way of working, comfortable in a fast moving scale up where not everything is documented yet.
  • Fluent English, German is a plus given our DACH customer base.


Why us?

Legartis exists to unlock legal work at scale.

  • Work in a Legal AI scale up with a flat hierarchy and a team that takes the work seriously without taking itself too seriously.
  • Real ownership from day one.
  • Competitive compensation package including participation in our Employee Stock Option Plan.
  • Hybrid work environment with at least two days / week in our Leipzig office.
  • Regular team events in Germany and Switzerland.
  • The chance to shape how a fast-growing GTM organization actually runs, not just report on it after the fact.

Your first 90 days

In your first month you audit the current HubSpot instance and ship the first version of our data foundation cleanup: lifecycle stages, lead status, attribution. By day 60 you deliver the first rep level pipeline dashboard for Sales leadership. By day 90 you have proposed a roadmap for lead routing, scoring and the next phase of GTM tooling integration.


Process

Send us your CV, a short note on why this role fits you is welcome. If we think that this could be a fit, we invite you to the application process:

  1. Conversation with the hiring manager to get to know each other
  2. Conversation with the line manager to understand the role better, including a technical deep dive on your engineering, integration and HubSpot experience.
  3. A practical engineering exercise based on a real Legartis scenario, so that you know what to expect from the job and that we understand how you work.
  4. A “meet the team” round to meet whom you would be working with.
  5. If there is a mutual fit, we welcome you to the team.

jobs.title: Investment Director (Diagnostics) - Lyon, France
jobs.description:
Location : Lyon, France

ABOUT ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services.

ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

THE TEAM

  • An global team with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines.
  • Alumni of INSEAD, Wharton, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others.
  • Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group, KKR), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Stryker, Phillips, Pfizer, Baxter, LivaNova, J&J, Galderma, Sanofi).

THE DIAGNOSTICS TEAM

The Director will serve as a senior investment professional with direct responsibility for sourcing, evaluating and executing investments across the Diagnostics portfolio. The Director will lead deal activity across an assigned geography, technology platform or investment theme, and will carry accountability for investment outcomes, value creation and portfolio company support.

This is a senior operating role combining strategic direction setting with hands-on deal execution, positioning the Director as a trusted senior advisor to Partners and portfolio management teams.

  • Investment Sourcing & Strategy
    • Drive sourcing and pipeline development across assigned Diagnostics sectors or geographies, identifying and cultivating relationships with sellers, intermediaries and LP co-investors.
    • Lead the formation and evolution of investment theses within assigned focus areas, including category mapping, competitive positioning and market trend analysis.
    • Serve as primary investment decision maker and deal sponsor, with direct accountability for investment committee presentations and recommendation.
    • Lead the negotiation of transaction terms, pricing and deal structure in partnership with Partners and external advisors.
  • Due Diligence & Execution
    • Oversee comprehensive commercial, financial and operational due diligence, working with external advisors to validate assumptions and identify key risks and levers.
    • Lead the development of post-acquisition value creation roadmaps, including 100-day plans and multi-year operating strategies.
    • Manage the investment committee approval process and coordinate all transaction closing mechanics with legal and finance teams.
  • Portfolio Leadership & Value Creation
    • Serve as the primary investment relationship owner for assigned portfolio companies, working directly with management teams on strategy, M&A, capital deployment and operational priorities.
    • Lead add-on acquisition identification, evaluation and execution, including syndication with co-investors.
    • Drive performance monitoring and problem-solving, escalating key decisions to Partners and intervention areas to senior management.
    • Sponsor and mentor portfolio company boards, ensuring robust governance and strategic clarity.
  • Team & Platform Development
    • Mentor and develop Senior Analysts and Associate-level team members, contributing to talent development and succession planning within the Diagnostics function.
    • Contribute to ARCHIMED's Diagnostics thought leadership and external positioning through conference participation, investor communication and industry engagement.
    • Identify and build capabilities across the Diagnostics platform to support scaling and evolution of the investment program.

Requirements

  • 8 to 12 years of investment or operating experience, with a strong track record in private equity investing, transaction execution or operational leadership within diagnostics sector.
  • Demonstrated success originating, evaluating and closing significant investments (€50 million+ enterprise value preferred), with evidence of value creation across the portfolio.
  • Deep expertise in the Diagnostics landscape, including brand strategy, omnichannel distribution, and regulatory dynamics .
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills. Able to command credibility with sophisticated management teams, institutional LPs and external partners.
  • Strong financial acumen and fluency with investment modeling, valuation and deal structuring. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required.
  • Proven operational judgment and the ability to translate market insights into concrete investment theses and deal opportunities.
  • Track record of building and leading high-performing teams. Comfort with mentoring junior professionals and shaping investment culture.
  • Strategic, entrepreneurial and partnership-minded. Takes ownership of outcomes, moves with pace and brings a builder's orientation to platform development.
  • Advanced degree preferred. MBA or equivalent experience strongly valued.
  • Embodies and reinforces ARCHIMED's cultural values of inclusion, meritocracy, partnership, accountability, client focus and trust.

jobs.description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !


Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Retail Merchandiser Europe en CDD à partir de maintenant, pour une durée de 6 mois minimum (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle Merchandising, rattaché(e) à la Responsable Retail Merchandising Europe vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

  • Création des assortiments pour nos projets spéciaux 2027 (pop-up, takeover grands magasins, rénovations, événements presse/influence): préparation des ouvertures et suivi hebdomadaire pour s'adapter au trend et aux besoins clients, en lien étroit avec les départements architecture, visuel merchandising et supply chain.
  • Coordination des sélections produits pour nos braderies et projets archives, en lien avec les équipes supply chain et visuel merchandising;
  • Réalisation d'analyses ad-hoc sur la performance de l’offre pour mettre en place des plans d’action concrets à court ou moyen terme ;
  • Interaction avec les points de vente de manière hebdomadaire pour les demandes d’ajustement de l’assortiment (demandes d’ajout, de retour…) ;
  • Participation aux visites de points de vente (floor et stock) afin de mettre en place des plans d’action visant à optimiser la satisfaction client ;
  • Support aux ouvertures des pops ups et projets spéciaux, via une présence terrain pour accompagner les équipes retail.

Requirements

  • Diplômé(e) d'une école de mode ou d’une école de commerce avec spécialisation mode, ou de son équivalent universitaire ;
  • Vous mettez en avant une expérience de minimum 3 ans sur un poste équivalent au sein d'une marque de prêt-à-porter ;
  • Vous disposez d’une forte sensibilité produit combinée à un œil business pragmatique ;
  • Vous êtes curieux(euse), proactif(ive) avec un sens entrepreneurial ;
  • Vous maitrisez Excel, et avez un goût prononcé pour l’analyse de données, vous savez vous appuyer sur l'IA pour gagner du temps ;
  • Vous êtes très organisé(e) et la gestion des priorités n'a pas de secret pour vous !
  • Anglais courant indispensable.


Vous vous êtes reconnu(e) dans ce descriptif et souhaitez rejoindre l’aventure Sézane ? Alors n’attendez plus !
